text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is an original research article focused on modeling the future distributions of emergent aquatic macrophytes under climate change scenarios in Finland. Although it uses spatial modeling with quantitative metrics and multiple climate scenarios, its primary focus is ecological/species distribution modeling of aquatic vegetation, not land use/land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation. The emergent aquatic macrophyte data are derived from land cover classification but are treated as species/ecological features rather than as LULC classes per se. The study does not explicitly focus on LULC future prediction as a central research question, but rather on ecological impacts of climate change on species distributions. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criterion of primary focus on LULC prediction and meets the exclusion criterion of species-specific/ecological focus unrelated to LULC prediction.)
